title: FDA approves first treatment for Sanfilippo syndrome type A
summary:
## Is there a treatment for Sanfilippo syndrome type A?

On 17 September 2026, the US Food and Drug Administration approved Fayuvi, the first treatment for children with Sanfilippo syndrome type A (MPS IIIA). Until now, care was limited to managing symptoms. The one-time gene therapy helps the body make an enzyme the disease leaves missing.

Published by Small Good Things
